group.author: Minsu
group.text: We've got menus and prices. What else could we show students to help them decide where to eat?

group.author: Taeho
group.text: What about putting wait times next to the menus? If both places have something I like, I'd go for the shorter line.

group.author: Soyeon
group.text: Yes! I'd check it before leaving class.

group.author: Minsu
group.text: Okay, I think we've got our idea. Let's propose that students can compare cafeteria menus, prices, and wait times to decide where to eat.

note: The tool was agreed in passing; what the prototype is (clickable mockup or working app) is the real question.

input.goal: Plan the prototype for the course demo

group.author: Minsu
group.text: For the prototype we could use Figma.

group.author: Soyeon
group.text: Sure, Figma is fine.

group.text: I could also hook it up to real menu data so it actually works.

group.text: A clickable mockup is probably enough for Friday though.

group.author: Minsu
group.text: Let's make a prototype for Friday's demo.

note: 'Friday' was said with two different times.

group.author: Soyeon
group.text: We should submit before the weekend.

group.author: Taeho
group.text: Friday works, the portal closes at midnight.

group.author: Soyeon
group.text: I'd rather we finish by Friday noon so we can check it together.

group.author: Minsu
group.text: Let's submit on Friday then.
